items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: And having had the opportunitcy to meet people in the record industry like Al Jolson and Jack Kapp, and Bing Crosby and Ella Fitzgerald...

ctx.x: Well, Fats had so many things going...

All right. Fats, he was on the radio. See, Fats used to come over a radio station in Cincinnati, or someplace. And really have an opportunity to play. Plus he could play. And then, too, you know, you gotta remember that a lot of these musicians had managers that were in the way. The managers were just in the way, so they prevented the man from really playing, you know, like he could play. Thinking like he could think. You know, a hundred dollars would really change a guy's mind.
